About Ipsos Askia 
 We are Ipsos Askia, we are passionate about technology and insights. Ipsos Askia's ambition is to power Ipsos with tailored solutions that generate actionable insights and unlock business growth.
 We are a team of 65+ people working across France, Germany, Romania and the UK. What truly sets us apart is our culture of empowerment and ownership, harmoniously working together to create value. Our continuous quest for innovative solutions is aimed at proactively meeting the needs of the business.
 About Ipsos Askia product – NGIE 
 Our goal is to make NGIE, our in-house platform, the primary survey data collection tool at Ipsos, replacing the current third-party solution. To achieve this, we are providing tools that collect information from respondents and address research objectives. We are expanding NGIE's capabilities in a scalable way to support business growth. Through daily collaboration and innovation, we steadily build confidence and fully unlock NGIE's potential to meet our clients' needs.
 Position Overview 
 We’re looking for a highly skilled Front-end Developer with a strong grasp of modern web technologies and a passion for innovation. You will join an agile, cross-functional team and help evolve Askia’s data-collection platform using a modern full-stack JavaScript/TypeScript toolchain. Your work will focus on building flexible, maintainable, and extensible codebases that stay resilient as features grow.
 Tech stack & ecosystem 
 Our main stack includes Svelte, SvelteKit, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Node.js, Vite, TailwindCSS, PostCSS, Vitest, Playwright, Storybook, Chromatic, Docker, and Google Cloud .
 Development Philosophy 
 We build modern web applications using: 
Component-Driven Development (CDD) – isolate, document, and test UI components to encourage single-responsibility and reusability.
Declarative & Reactive Programming – describe what the UI should look like, letting the framework handle the how, which reduces coupling and eases future extensions.
Universal / Full-Stack JavaScript – leverage a single language across client and server for seamless SSR and API development, promoting clear contracts and predictable dependencies.
Automated Quality – unit, integration, and visual-regression testing (Vitest, Playwright, Storybook/Chromatic) with CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that small, focused modules can evolve safely.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain modern front-end applications and user interfaces for Ipsos Askia product 
Deliver clean, reusable, and scalable code aligned with industry best practices and coding standards
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers, QA Engineers, and Developers throughout the software development lifecycle
Analyze existing solutions and propose enhancements to improve performance, usability, and maintainability
Implement and consume REST APIs while ensuring seamless integration between front-end and back-end services
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues reported by customers, QA teams, or stakeholders
Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making processes
Participate actively in agile ceremonies, sprint planning, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
Support the deployment, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of developed applications
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing solutions and development practices.
 Requirements: 
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in frontend developement
Strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as: React / Next.js, Vue / Nuxt, SolidJS, Astro, Svelte (strong advantage)
Solid understanding of: TypeScript, component-based architectures, design patterns and scalable application design, responsive web development, state management concepts
Experience with: REST APIs, Git version control, automated testing practices, CI/CD environments, Docker (Kubernetes exposure is a plus)
Working knowledge of databases and data structures.
Familiarity with design systems (knowledge of Carbon Design System is considered an advantage).
